title: Mediterranean Pesto Haloumi & Veggie Risotto
subtitle: with Goat's Cheese
description: Our Mediterranean seasoning and basil pesto add a rich depth of flavour to this veggie risotto. With the likes of leek, tomato, zucchini, haloumi, marinated goat cheese and flaked almonds, this is a solid meal fit for a Queen or King.

steps.text:
•

• Boil the kettle. Preheat oven to 240°C/220°C fan-forced.

• Thinly slice leek. Roughly chop tomato. Grate zucchini. Drain and reserve oil from marinated goat cheese and set aside.

• In a medium bowl, place haloumi and cover with water to soak.

• Heat a large ovenproof saucepan over high heat with a drizzle of the reserved goat cheese oil.

• Cook leek, stirring, until browned and softened, 4-5 minutes.

•

• Reduce heat to medium-high, then add tomatoes and cook, stirring, until softened, 2-3 minutes. 
• Add Mediterranean seasoning, zucchini and risotto rice to pan and cook, stirring until fragrant, 1 minute. 
• Remove saucepan from heat, then stir in stock concentrate and the boiling water(see ingredients).

•

• Cover with a lid or tightly with foil.

• Bake until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is ‘al dente’, 24-28 minutes. 

• Meanwhile, drain haloumi and pat dry. Cut the haloumi into bite-sized chunks.

• In a large frying pan, heat a generous drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat.

• When oil is hot, cook haloumi, tossing occasionally, until golden brown, 2-4 minutes.

• Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel.

•

• Uncover risotto, then stir through basil pesto and cooked haloumi until combined. Season to taste with salt and pepper. 
• Divide Mediterranean haloumi pesto veggie risotto between bowls. 
• Top with goat cheese and flaked almonds to serve. Enjoy! 


TIP: If the rice is dry, add a splash of water and stir through.
